name: When should I consider replacing my interior window trim?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my interior window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your interior window trim if it shows signs of significant damage like rot, severe warping, or extensive cracking that can't be repaired. Outdated styles that detract from your home's aesthetic or trim that doesn't seal properly can also be reasons for replacement. Replacing trim during a window replacement project is often efficient, but it can also be a standalone update to refresh a room. We can assess your existing trim in areas like Caldwell to determine if replacement or repair is the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace interior window trim if it's damaged, severely warped, or cracking, or if you want to update outdated styles.
